A stomach ache after drinking alcohol ` [Highlight start] usually happens because alcohol irritates your stomach lining, increases stomach acid, and triggers reflux or inflammation [Highlight end] ` . Mild discomfort often eases within a day once you stop drinking, hydrate, and rest your stomach, though severe or lasting pain needs medical care.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXyPhIgEVMg6ZJSY6Bmiz9lVVDCkISA0kuGSVK1FGBuLX5Yo9XgA2FNlnhOw8dLeJbPKmvjx6zqLywWaGCtc5QVvWharC-ZUItw4QASVhjB3G2kwYIyN9aYShCZwj39NOfHoPsIpgPSACv-cLm0IUUDKM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXLRbZScwCJIYG3OZ8BHXXVRYpoGU_u9gFhVGEGrrWT0C4rZpg33hHeWTYQ9mX9-jKOoNaehEB633t4_tp0dVAv_QZNvaqU7T5hOJcg7Scy893GuC4QmKqbr0ojfmAgpH_zrPar5p-4TNxTFTyxRjDiARUa7s)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF15fc8OtVtRzUZPC9At_yCTVU1FkjU_9i-tUZiu3NbKXcPA931UHVCEEGV7ViPIk0zBX_5zJC2SLFCLwNOrGNiZJEjiuG_Zjx5VKUQpyo1xBBEaVacyzCkq1IMKi2hfnXKNZffYopjKhoDr8Eg-vXKTef7J1mNdUh193ovMBDTLk)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF19Jbf-aDY1tiok0003QNa_IYA01NaUe866iY25sgtNovoWESmyWX2gY0rwkC1HUvJ1Uq97BtpzhAaO5hyX6dj2h0--kVeOzkFRqNui4i8QSwBaPUcGn5hSp6Tgaft5b7ddSD24CReUPOWKdeNsPHIMEDM6fCxZXMvOyeHCuPvFLfUXLDNYuo7BjKYfg-4tXQ9CozE-7EHM0QtLg)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF190u1DE--rBlVP4wye-ryQ79VmQ04yXjWZYAB5BpWNQ8AfvRdRks2EEJf989X2yBLzqtn_bmxHRJLUZBRGMVKUyKECIovLEgLiIxgTeufjMta6Xwzzf7bCm05O9w2f7wY2iPNTc0wCETDhOSiM4DgXiKtgPEdPUBeEo3dH0c)

### Common Causes

- **Gastritis (alcoholic gastritis):** Alcohol weakens the stomach's protective mucus layer and inflames the lining, causing burning, cramping, or nausea.
- **Acid reflux and heartburn:** Alcohol relaxes the valve between your esophagus and stomach, letting acid rise up.
- **Bloating and gut irritation:** Alcohol alters gut movement and digestion, leading to gas, bloating, or diarrhea.
- **Stomach ulcers:** Repeated irritation and acid exposure can wear down the lining enough to form painful ulcers.
- **Pancreatitis:** Heavy or binge drinking can inflame the pancreas, causing intense upper abdominal pain that may spread to the back.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF190u1DE--rBlVP4wye-ryQ79VmQ04yXjWZYAB5BpWNQ8AfvRdRks2EEJf989X2yBLzqtn_bmxHRJLUZBRGMVKUyKECIovLEgLiIxgTeufjMta6Xwzzf7bCm05O9w2f7wY2iPNTc0wCETDhOSiM4DgXiKtgPEdPUBeEo3dH0c)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXyPhIgEVMg6ZJSY6Bmiz9lVVDCkISA0kuGSVK1FGBuLX5Yo9XgA2FNlnhOw8dLeJbPKmvjx6zqLywWaGCtc5QVvWharC-ZUItw4QASVhjB3G2kwYIyN9aYShCZwj39NOfHoPsIpgPSACv-cLm0IUUDKM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXLRbZScwCJIYG3OZ8BHXXVRYpoGU_u9gFhVGEGrrWT0C4rZpg33hHeWTYQ9mX9-jKOoNaehEB633t4_tp0dVAv_QZNvaqU7T5hOJcg7Scy893GuC4QmKqbr0ojfmAgpH_zrPar5p-4TNxTFTyxRjDiARUa7s)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1_9B4HbkkIn7gd1zEII_CPqVzOB_4r6hH7P7t-jOiQ4DzByu76G0sX1K2hmHFvRMvj5FmP1VEgSHM2hbSF1fNWSwKHNDnFPDsry9hvLUph-kMucsXqxaG4bUPpHv53HpL65L3Z9AYOzwby7H6C2KLD0XA2-kgpmtSpNZbZyV2uHlBU-8TprOj1rvTQ)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXkSoBS2BVZObt1qixac50EhoCgW4k_rIVtRue9y2HxAes0gFMrV9RCHfT9b5BkfQZFYULL8I9SweTCxsUw5-fNjGwvapZVnVNLj7_i6JuUsWDAiXtGQHOQlFU_rdwGv7UAA)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF19Jbf-aDY1tiok0003QNa_IYA01NaUe866iY25sgtNovoWESmyWX2gY0rwkC1HUvJ1Uq97BtpzhAaO5hyX6dj2h0--kVeOzkFRqNui4i8QSwBaPUcGn5hSp6Tgaft5b7ddSD24CReUPOWKdeNsPHIMEDM6fCxZXMvOyeHCuPvFLfUXLDNYuo7BjKYfg-4tXQ9CozE-7EHM0QtLg)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17z2GKrYmWea7YjxRUwjdc27EJZV5cXnytvgwctvKmxTtxO7Cl9ZJksLlLZ-CclTKBHWAwl2m8GnDh9oHLu0JQ7MAGeJxZRdMfBUct7_xVsl9Hgu0GzAQpwhV_ty7NiBmocm_R69z7Zu6171G2JnNSOSvKzghbu0OhSiMGiyPJuMEKM)

### Basic Relief Steps

- **Stop drinking alcohol** to let your stomach lining recover.
- **Sip water or electrolyte drinks** to rehydrate.
- **Eat bland foods** like crackers, toast, rice, bananas, or oatmeal when you feel ready, and avoid spicy, acidic, or greasy foods.
- **Use caution with pain relievers:** Avoid NSAIDs (like ibuprofen or aspirin), as they can further irritate your stomach lining. For more details on recovery and treatment options, see [WebMD's overview of alcoholic gastritis](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF183f6bcaFxf1FzhGq9i6B4KA24G4TVcllOnZf0DSLvjpsDQyl4WDVYGER3_H-1hOCI9tWHqtPryZNGq4drvQXz2Tz81kpr85i5UAwZfMAc6drFmObYA9iJtnZxIgqCMwoZT9Gg4Nb-rEAoRW2q6LPy9HbSRK8kw7SKkDmoP7BvQZ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXyPhIgEVMg6ZJSY6Bmiz9lVVDCkISA0kuGSVK1FGBuLX5Yo9XgA2FNlnhOw8dLeJbPKmvjx6zqLywWaGCtc5QVvWharC-ZUItw4QASVhjB3G2kwYIyN9aYShCZwj39NOfHoPsIpgPSACv-cLm0IUUDKM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF183f6bcaFxf1FzhGq9i6B4KA24G4TVcllOnZf0DSLvjpsDQyl4WDVYGER3_H-1hOCI9tWHqtPryZNGq4drvQXz2Tz81kpr85i5UAwZfMAc6drFmObYA9iJtnZxIgqCMwoZT9Gg4Nb-rEAoRW2q6LPy9HbSRK8kw7SKkDmoP7BvQZ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF15fc8OtVtRzUZPC9At_yCTVU1FkjU_9i-tUZiu3NbKXcPA931UHVCEEGV7ViPIk0zBX_5zJC2SLFCLwNOrGNiZJEjiuG_Zjx5VKUQpyo1xBBEaVacyzCkq1IMKi2hfnXKNZffYopjKhoDr8Eg-vXKTef7J1mNdUh193ovMBDTLk)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17z2GKrYmWea7YjxRUwjdc27EJZV5cXnytvgwctvKmxTtxO7Cl9ZJksLlLZ-CclTKBHWAwl2m8GnDh9oHLu0JQ7MAGeJxZRdMfBUct7_xVsl9Hgu0GzAQpwhV_ty7NiBmocm_R69z7Zu6171G2JnNSOSvKzghbu0OhSiMGiyPJuMEKM)

Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF194hZcHQ4aPD3u8ZLsUeC9WjSRuTzk2E_j8m0ZVsn9PdzrRzDAoE70qlkOdBMAhjwSQyImgSZB_TsXvsp1c-m1Zvopd5nY-y798oW3h5yxnANxIOfUDhru9-DsFBqtE4JqgtLM4ywKAZZelLTZ_QspXG2YschUV-PJuqGb4TZqugnqoyFXZhELbLeR7O8jcFyMs0) agree that ongoing or upper stomach pain after drinking warrants stopping alcohol and seeing a doctor for proper testing. If you are also looking into structured support around alcohol use, [ETHOS Treatment](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXyPhIgEVMg6ZJSY6Bmiz9lVVDCkISA0kuGSVK1FGBuLX5Yo9XgA2FNlnhOw8dLeJbPKmvjx6zqLywWaGCtc5QVvWharC-ZUItw4QASVhjB3G2kwYIyN9aYShCZwj39NOfHoPsIpgPSACv-cLm0IUUDKM) offers outpatient programs and alcohol support groups.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXyPhIgEVMg6ZJSY6Bmiz9lVVDCkISA0kuGSVK1FGBuLX5Yo9XgA2FNlnhOw8dLeJbPKmvjx6zqLywWaGCtc5QVvWharC-ZUItw4QASVhjB3G2kwYIyN9aYShCZwj39NOfHoPsIpgPSACv-cLm0IUUDKM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF194hZcHQ4aPD3u8ZLsUeC9WjSRuTzk2E_j8m0ZVsn9PdzrRzDAoE70qlkOdBMAhjwSQyImgSZB_TsXvsp1c-m1Zvopd5nY-y798oW3h5yxnANxIOfUDhru9-DsFBqtE4JqgtLM4ywKAZZelLTZ_QspXG2YschUV-PJuqGb4TZqugnqoyFXZhELbLeR7O8jcFyMs0)

### When to Seek Urgent Care
Get prompt medical attention if you have:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF190u1DE--rBlVP4wye-ryQ79VmQ04yXjWZYAB5BpWNQ8AfvRdRks2EEJf989X2yBLzqtn_bmxHRJLUZBRGMVKUyKECIovLEgLiIxgTeufjMta6Xwzzf7bCm05O9w2f7wY2iPNTc0wCETDhOSiM4DgXiKtgPEdPUBeEo3dH0c)

- Severe or worsening abdominal pain, especially pain radiating to your back
- Persistent vomiting or vomiting material that looks like blood or coffee grounds
- Fever, dizziness, fainting, or a rapid pulse
- Pain that lasts longer than 24 hours to a few days[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF183f6bcaFxf1FzhGq9i6B4KA24G4TVcllOnZf0DSLvjpsDQyl4WDVYGER3_H-1hOCI9tWHqtPryZNGq4drvQXz2Tz81kpr85i5UAwZfMAc6drFmObYA9iJtnZxIgqCMwoZT9Gg4Nb-rEAoRW2q6LPy9HbSRK8kw7SKkDmoP7BvQZ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF190u1DE--rBlVP4wye-ryQ79VmQ04yXjWZYAB5BpWNQ8AfvRdRks2EEJf989X2yBLzqtn_bmxHRJLUZBRGMVKUyKECIovLEgLiIxgTeufjMta6Xwzzf7bCm05O9w2f7wY2iPNTc0wCETDhOSiM4DgXiKtgPEdPUBeEo3dH0c)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXsg2DtGWa2baGdFwbZJN8pLrOUxl-dJDYzrrJDidKBrgPY-7cnvqhMucu5CJ-_zi7EFYfW1F2lE5fQJSU-avqqzOGX6nR3dKHQDSyQ0NINuJfJfxQUmGf1ybPOfSqP2HZGp687rA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXyPhIgEVMg6ZJSY6Bmiz9lVVDCkISA0kuGSVK1FGBuLX5Yo9XgA2FNlnhOw8dLeJbPKmvjx6zqLywWaGCtc5QVvWharC-ZUItw4QASVhjB3G2kwYIyN9aYShCZwj39NOfHoPsIpgPSACv-cLm0IUUDKM)

To help me give more tailored information, could you share:

- **What the pain feels like** (such as burning, sharp cramping, or bloating) and **where it is located** 
- **How long it has lasted** and any **other symptoms** like nausea, vomiting, or fever
- Whether you want to explore **at-home symptom relief**, **possible causes** , or **when to see a doctor**

For more details on recovery and treatment options, see [WebMD's overview of alcoholic gastritis](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF183f6bcaFxf1FzhGq9i6B4KA24G4TVcllOnZf0DSLvjpsDQyl4WDVYGER3_H-1hOCI9tWHqtPryZNGq4drvQXz2Tz81kpr85i5UAwZfMAc6drFmObYA9iJtnZxIgqCMwoZT9Gg4Nb-rEAoRW2q6LPy9HbSRK8kw7SKkDmoP7BvQZ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXyPhIgEVMg6ZJSY6Bmiz9lVVDCkISA0kuGSVK1FGBuLX5Yo9XgA2FNlnhOw8dLeJbPKmvjx6zqLywWaGCtc5QVvWharC-ZUItw4QASVhjB3G2kwYIyN9aYShCZwj39NOfHoPsIpgPSACv-cLm0IUUDKM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF183f6bcaFxf1FzhGq9i6B4KA24G4TVcllOnZf0DSLvjpsDQyl4WDVYGER3_H-1hOCI9tWHqtPryZNGq4drvQXz2Tz81kpr85i5UAwZfMAc6drFmObYA9iJtnZxIgqCMwoZT9Gg4Nb-rEAoRW2q6LPy9HbSRK8kw7SKkDmoP7BvQZ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF15fc8OtVtRzUZPC9At_yCTVU1FkjU_9i-tUZiu3NbKXcPA931UHVCEEGV7ViPIk0zBX_5zJC2SLFCLwNOrGNiZJEjiuG_Zjx5VKUQpyo1xBBEaVacyzCkq1IMKi2hfnXKNZffYopjKhoDr8Eg-vXKTef7J1mNdUh193ovMBDTLk)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF17z2GKrYmWea7YjxRUwjdc27EJZV5cXnytvgwctvKmxTtxO7Cl9ZJksLlLZ-CclTKBHWAwl2m8GnDh9oHLu0JQ7MAGeJxZRdMfBUct7_xVsl9Hgu0GzAQpwhV_ty7NiBmocm_R69z7Zu6171G2JnNSOSvKzghbu0OhSiMGiyPJuMEKM)
